event: Give border-only OpenDRIVE lanes their widths (#577)
scope: The reader makes width records from the <border> records of a lane that has no <width>, as ASAM OpenDRIVE 1.8.1 section 11.6.2 defines them, and refuses the border combinations that ASAM forbids. All later geometry reads width records, so no certified, pinned or sign-query source changes.
